acceptance: A new scenario id and pre-registration define both arms and name review-findings-match as the decision check.
Calibration for review-findings-match is confirmed valid on the day (judge.py calibrate output saved), and the owner's judge window is recorded.
The 10-session pilot result for 'not told' is recorded, and the scored run happened only if fewer than 8 passed.
Counts, band and Holm p-value are reported for the comparison, with skills_read per arm.
The gate outcome is recorded; if within or inconclusive, nothing was built.
If a trigger was built: its loading rate in review sessions and near-miss firing count are reported against the bar, and the owner's approval precedes any install.
Ledger total is 40 USD or less.
context: Existing result folders: ~/.tractable/finding-drafts/skill-sync-skills/2026-11-15-ablation-eval/phase2/ and .../phase3/ (private, not committed).
description: Problem: the code-first rule fires on edits, so a review, which edits nothing, never triggers it. In the trigger evaluation Sonnet loaded review-protocol in 8/18 explicit and 3/18 implicit sessions and code in 0/18. Phase 2 found review-only behaviour held without any instructions (30/30), so it is not known that the missing text costs anything. Outcome: evidence on whether loading the review skills changes review quality, and a tested trigger only if it does. Arms on Sonnet 5.5, 30 sessions each, on a new scenario id built from the planted-defect review task: 'told to read' (the prompt begins by telling the agent to read skill://review-protocol and skill://code) and 'not told' (same skills available, prompt unchanged). Decision check: the judged check review-findings-match; report skills_read per arm. Decision gate, fixed before the runs: first judge a discarded 10-session pilot of 'not told'; if 8 or more pass review-findings-match, the test cannot reach keep, so record it as insensitive and close without the scored run. Otherwise build a trigger only if 'told to read' is keep against 'not told' (a lead of at least 30 points, Holm p < 0.01). If within or inconclusive, close with the result and build nothing. A trigger is adopted only if it loads review-protocol in at least 80% of review sessions and fires in 0 near-miss sessions, and it is installed for the user only after the owner approves. Guardrails: (1) agents under test run only in /tmp/omp-ablation sandboxes through evals/ablation/run.py or the loading-map probe, and through replay.py only after replay-disable-user-rules is merged; (2) change nothing under ~/.omp/agent, ~/.claude or ~/.agents while sessions run, upgrade neither omp, Claude Code nor tractable-mcp during a run, and start no run while another evaluation is running; (3) commit the pre-registration (hypothesis, arms, checks, sample, decision, Holm family and alpha) before any scored session; smoke runs never count; (4) use a new out folder and a ledger with the ceiling stated here; stop at the ceiling and report; raising it needs the owner's approval in a later message; (5) record the omp, Claude Code and tractable-mcp versions with the results; never pool new sessions with results from another harness version; new comparisons form their own Holm family and published bands are left unchanged; (6) existing scenarios and pre-registration files are not edited: new arms use new scenario ids and a new pre-registration file, and run.py report or phase3_bands.py over the existing result folders gives the same output before and after; (7) read at least 5 transcripts per arm before reporting any number, and report grader faults found; (8) delete or weaken no instruction or skill text on this evidence; (9) a published number in a report is never rewritten: add a dated note after it; (10) scenario and scratch code that produced a result is committed with it; (11) if a result changes a claim in the blog post 'Testing agent instructions', correct the draft by PR; if the post is published, open a PR that adds a dated correction note and updates its 'updated' time, and merge it only after the owner approves in a later message, because a merge to main of joeharris76.com deploys the public site; (12) publish by task branch and draft PR with identity Joe Harris <joeharris76@gmail.com>; the item stays open until its PR is merged through the repository's usual flow (green CI, squash merge), and anything this item reserves for the owner is not merged or installed without the owner's message. Spend ceiling 40 USD. Spend gate: before the first paid session, tell the owner the ceiling and wait for a go-ahead in a later message; the item is blocked until then. Judged checks: the judge is openai-codex/gpt-6.1-sol on the ChatGPT plan quota (about 50 sessions per 5 hours, 300 a week), which the runner does not cap; estimate the judge calls, ask the owner for a window before starting, and stop if the quota runs out; never substitute a judge from the Claude family. A judged check counts only while its calibration is valid (agreement at least 0.90 on at least 15 passes and 15 fails) for the current judge, rubric and evidence script. State as a limit that calibration labels came from a Claude model.
